permitDetails.description: Permit-level metadata extracted exactly from the document. Do not infer or normalize beyond date formatting.

permitNumber.description: The permit number or registration identifier exactly as written (e.g., '52432', '21050040'). Extract the primary numeric/alphanumeric identifier, excluding labels like 'Registration No.:' or 'Permit'. If multiple identifiers exist, select the primary one and document others in extractionNotes.

permitIssuanceDate.description: Date the permit was issued in YYYY-MM-DD format if unambiguous; otherwise null.

permitExpirationDate.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format if explicitly stated; otherwise null.

facilityName.description: Facility name exactly as written in the permit. Do not normalize.

facilityAddress.description: Full facility street address exactly as written. Do not normalize.

facilityCounty.description: County name exactly as written in the permit.

initialConstructionCommencedNotification.description: True if permit requires notification of construction commencement date. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

constructionCommencedNotificationWindowD.description: Number of days within which construction commencement must be reported (e.g., 30). Leave null if not specified.

initialStartupNotificationRequired.description: True if permit requires notification of initial startup date. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

startupNotificationWindowDays.description: Number of days within which startup must be reported (e.g., 15). Leave null if not specified.

permitCopyOnsiteRequired.description: True if permit requires keeping a copy onsite. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

rightOfEntryClause.description: Free-text excerpt of right-of-entry language enabling inspection, especially noting timing (e.g., 'whenever the facility is in operation'). Leave null if not stated.

extractionNotes.description: Optional notes for documenting permit-level extraction decisions. Use ONLY when: (1) multiple permit identifiers exist and you selected the primary one; (2) ambiguity in facility name or address required clarification; (3) date format was ambiguous. Leave null if extraction was straightforward.

generatorSets.description: Array of generator set objects. Do not consolidate generator sets even if they share make/model. List in order they appear in the document.

items.description: One entry per generator unit or group as listed in the permit (e.g., EG01, EG04-EG05, 1510-4).

referenceNumber.description: Unit or group identifier exactly as used in the permit (e.g., 'EG01', 'EG04-EG05', '1510-4').

numGenerators.description: Count of engines in this reference. Use number explicitly tied to this reference; otherwise null.

includedInPermitProject.description: True if explicitly listed as included in this permitting action; false if listed as previously permitted equipment; null if not distinguished.

make.description: If multiple makes/models are listed for the same reference (e.g., 'Caterpillar 3516C or MTU 16V4000 DS2250 or equivalent'), select one deterministically: (1) prefer the option with the smallest stated electrical rating (kW); (2) if kW is not given for all, compare BHP and pick the smallest; (3) if still tied, pick the first explicitly named make. Copy the chosen make verbatim as a single value. Do not include 'or', 'equivalent', or list multiple options. Document alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

model.description: If multiple models are listed (e.g., 'Caterpillar 3516C or MTU 16V4000 DS2250 or equivalent'), select deterministically using the same rule as 'make': (1) prefer the model with the smallest stated electrical rating (kW); (2) if kW not given, compare BHP and pick smallest; (3) if tied, pick first explicitly named model. Copy the chosen model verbatim as a single value. Do not include 'or' or list multiple models. Document alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

ratedCapacityKW.description: Numeric kW nameplate for the selected make/model only. If multiple kW values are shown (e.g., '2,500 kW each or 2,250 kW each'), record the smallest stated kW as a single number. Do not convert from BHP. Do not include 'or' or text. Document higher alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

ratedCapacityBHP.description: Numeric BHP nameplate for the selected make/model only. If multiple BHP values are shown, record the smallest stated BHP as a single number. Do not convert from kW. Do not include 'or' or text. Document higher alternatives in extractionNotes. Leave null if not stated.

maximumCapacityBHP.description: Maximum capacity in brake horsepower if explicitly stated; otherwise null.

maximumCapacityKW.description: Maximum capacity in kilowatts if explicitly stated; otherwise null.

primaryFuelType.description: Primary fuel type exactly as written in permit (e.g., 'diesel fuel', 'no. 2 distillate', 'ultra-low sulfur diesel', 'natural gas', 'propane'). Do not normalize or infer. Leave null if not stated.

secondaryFuelType.description: Secondary fuel type for dual-fuel generators exactly as written. Leave null if not applicable.

otherFuels.description: Additional fuels beyond primary and secondary, as free text. Leave null if not applicable.

fuelGrade.description: Fuel grade if explicitly stated (e.g., 'Grade No. 2-D', 'Grade No. 1-D S15'). Copy verbatim. Leave null if not stated.

fuelSpecification.description: Fuel specification standard if cited (e.g., 'ASTM D975', 'ASTM D396'). Copy verbatim. Leave null if not stated.

fuelSulfurContentPct.description: Sulfur content as percent (e.g., 0.0015 for 0.0015% or 15 ppm). Extract as percent regardless of how stated in permit. Leave null if not stated.

fuelCertificationRequired.description: True if fuel supplier certification is explicitly required with each shipment. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

supplierNameRequired.description: True if supplier name is required in certification.

receiptDateRequired.description: True if receipt/delivery date is required in certification.

quantityRequired.description: True if quantity/volume is required in certification.

astmComplianceStatementRequired.description: True if ASTM compliance statement is required in certification.

sulfurContentRequired.description: True if sulfur content is required in certification.

fuelCertificationFields.description: Breakdown of required fuel certification fields if certification is required. Leave null if certification not required or fields not specified.

fuelChangePermitTrigger.description: Free-text excerpt of permit language describing when fuel changes trigger permit modification (e.g., 'A change in the fuel may require a new or amended permit'). Leave null if not stated.

fuelThroughputLimit.description: Maximum fuel consumption as numeric value only (e.g., gallons per year). Leave null if not stated.

fuelThroughputScope.description: Scope of fuel throughput limit: 'per_unit' (each generator), 'combined_group' (multiple generators combined), or 'facility_wide'. Leave null if not stated.

fuelThroughputGroupRef.description: Reference to generator group when throughput is combined (e.g., 'EG01-EG07'). Leave null if not applicable.

controlTechnology.description: Emission control technology or devices as written in permit (e.g., 'turbocharged engine and aftercooler', 'SCR', 'DOC'). Leave null if not specified.

operatingHoursLimit.description: Maximum allowed operating hours per year as numeric value. Leave null if not specified.

operatingHoursRollingWindow.description: Rolling window method exactly as written (e.g., 'consecutive 12-month period; calculated monthly'). Leave null if not specified.

allowedOperatingModes.description: Operating modes allowed exactly as written in permit (e.g., 'emergency only', 'emergency, maintenance and testing', 'emergency and non-emergency with approval'). Leave null if not specified.

opacityLimitPercent.description: Opacity limit as percent if explicitly stated (e.g., 20 for 20%). Leave null if not stated.

hourMeterRequired.description: True if hour meter is explicitly required. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

observationFrequency.description: Monitoring/observation frequency exactly as written (e.g., 'daily when operated', 'monthly', 'quarterly'). Leave null if not specified.

recordkeepingWindowYears.description: Number of years to retain records if explicitly stated (e.g., 5). Leave null if not specified.

operationReasonLogRequired.description: True if permit explicitly requires logging operation reasons (date, cause, hours) for each run. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

manufacturerOandMRequired.description: True if manufacturer's operation and maintenance procedures/instructions are explicitly required. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

maintenanceTrainingRecordsRequired.description: True if maintenance records and operator training records are explicitly required. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

nspsSubpartIIII.description: True if NSPS Subpart IIII is explicitly stated as applicable. False if explicitly stated as not applicable. Null if not mentioned.

mactSubpartZZZZ.description: True if MACT Subpart ZZZZ is explicitly stated as applicable. False if explicitly stated as not applicable. Null if not mentioned.

extractionNotes.description: Optional notes documenting extraction decisions (e.g., multiple make/model options, capacity ambiguities). Leave null if straightforward.
